firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: one action name everywhere (header + hero link 'Start my window schedule'), the 'tagged' box now sits over the jamb on purpose, and the coral key-plan band peeks by about 90px. 390-first.jpg: photo + W1/W2 tags + Call/Text sit above the fold. The proof line is still below the fold at 390.

distinctiveness.notes: The hex-tag schedule system runs through hero, key plan (1440-rm-full.jpg), process strip (1440-scroll-25.jpg), service tags (1440-scroll-50.jpg), reviews (1440-scroll-75.jpg) and the footer (1440-full.jpg). Still an eyebrow over every h2 plus mono middle-dot strings (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: service-card body is now full-ink at readable size. Spectral/Onest/JetBrains Mono keep their roles, and the Spectral review quotes are strong (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Mono captions stay small and grey (1440-full.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 1440-rm-full.jpg #keyplan: the photo stops about 280px short of its stage, leaving a dead sand band above the coral caption (-0.5). #area now has one job (ZIP + tagged towns), and office hours moved into #contact (1440-full.jpg). Process still runs about 3.6 screens (1440-scroll-25.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: the key plan is now a Gulf flat-roof stucco house in the hero's light, so the grade matches. But the lower half of the frame is lawn and driveway, and the tags crowd into the top 30% (-0.5). The pool-court frame (1440-scroll-50.jpg) is the duller grade still.

copy.notes: 1440-first.jpg / end of 1440-full.jpg: one phrase for the primary action, 'Start my window schedule', in the header, hero, sheet and form h2. Trade nouns are real (sill pan, rough opening, SHGC), and Sample labels are on every review, rating and price (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: composed for the phone, with the photo, tags and both actions above the fold and a sticky bar. render.json shows no overflow at 320/390. 390-full.jpg: process cards are stacked with the strip in 2 columns.

a11y.notes: 390-rm-full.jpg / 1440-rm-full.jpg show every word, the key-plan photo and all 5 tags. Heading order is clean (dist), inputs are labelled, the form band call button uses dark text on light teal (1440-full.jpg). Mono grey captions are the weakest text but readable.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the strip ticks per step and the jamb drawing changes state (ORDERED ship wk). 390-full.jpg #keyplan: with motion on, the stage is an empty sand box (photo and tags absent). In 1440-full.jpg only a faded W1 has arrived. The reveal still leaves the section blank (-0.5).

wow.notes: The schedule strip fills on scroll (1440-scroll-25.jpg) and returns as the navy price sheet (1440-full.jpg). The measure tool speaks the tag language. The key plan with 5 tags in reduced motion (390-rm-full.jpg) is the show-a-partner moment, when it renders.

polish.notes: Favicon, theme-color, OG, JSON-LD, print + forced-colors, 2px radius system, designed 'Schedule closed.' footer (1440-full.jpg). The key-plan dead band is counted under layout.

elevate.move: Make the key plan a scrubbed survey: the photo is there from the first pixel (no clip-from-blank), then a scan line crosses the house left to right on scroll and drops each tag W4→W1→W2→W3→D1 as it passes the opening, ticking '1 of 5 … 5 of 5 openings' in the Sheet A-1 card. The motion counts openings; it never hides the house.

Re-cut #keyplan as a drawing sheet: crop the photo to the house band (lose the lawn), let it fill the stage edge to edge, and set a thin title-block rail under it (sheet, openings, scale, 'tags are an example') in place of the coral caption strip, so the section reads as one plan sheet with no dead space.
